items.briefing:
A new phishing technique is circulating that uses "blob URLs" inside Microsoft's browser to disguise malicious links, making them harder to spot — staff should be cautious clicking any unexpected links, even if they appear to come from trusted sources. Separately, a vulnerability has been identified in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, so anyone managing an online store on these platforms should apply patches promptly.

A new report also highlights that Australian security leaders are struggling with limited resources as AI-related risks grow — a reminder that all staff play a role in staying alert. **Practical tip:** Before clicking any link in an email, hover over it to preview the destination address, and report anything suspicious to your IT team.

featured.title: Proofpoint report flags resourcing gap as Australian CISOs take on AI risk
